description: Defines an abstract class JdbcValueHandler with nested classes for handling various JDBC data types, including methods for mapping Java types to SQL types, serializing objects, and reading/writing database values.

classes.name: JdbcValueHandler
classes.description: Abstract class for handling JDBC column value get/set operations with nested type-specific handlers.

classes.name: TimestampJdbcValueHandler
classes.description: Handles java.sql.Timestamp type, with special handling for CHAR SQL type.

methods.name: createJdbcValueHandlerMap
methods.description: Creates a map of Java type names to their corresponding JdbcValueHandler instances.

methods.name: createSqlTypeMap
methods.description: Creates a map of SQL type names to java.sql.Types constants.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves a JdbcValueHandler instance based on Java type and SQL type strings.

methods.name: parseSqlType
methods.description: Parses SQL type string to extract the base type name.

methods.name: serializeObject
methods.description: Serializes an object to a byte array for storage.
